CustomField.description: First payment period this payout covers, in YYYY-MM. Together with Period End it declares the covered range, so a commission line that arrives later inside this range can be flagged as a late arrival.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: YYYY-MM 형식으로 입력하세요 (예: 2026-01). 이 지급이 커버하는 첫 달입니다.
CustomField.label: Period Start
